description: Retrieve the accounts associated with the connected Plaid item, optionally filtered to specific account ids. Each account includes embedded balances.

account_ids.description: Optional list of account_id strings to restrict the results to specific accounts.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with accounts (each including balances), item, and request_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Retrieve real-time balances for the accounts on the connected Plaid item, optionally filtered to specific account ids. Same shape as get_accounts with balances embedded in each account.

account_ids.description: Optional list of account_id strings to restrict the results to specific accounts.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with accounts (each including balances), item, and request_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Retrieve transactions for the connected Plaid item, optionally filtered by date range and account ids, sorted by date descending and paginated with count and offset.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; only transactions on or after this date are returned.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; only transactions on or before this date are returned.

account_ids.description: Optional list of account_id strings to restrict the results to specific accounts.

count.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (clamped between 1 and 500, default 100).

offset.description: Number of transactions to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with accounts, transactions (the current page), total_transactions, item, and request_id; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Retrieve details for a financial institution by its institution_id.

institution_id.description: The unique identifier of the institution to look up.

country_codes.description: Optional list of ISO country code strings (accepted for Plaid compatibility, does not affect the result).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the institution and request_id; on failure (institution not found), output contains an error message.

description: Retrieve account owner identity information (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses) for the accounts on the connected Plaid item, optionally filtered to specific account ids.

account_ids.description: Optional list of account_id strings to restrict the results to specific accounts.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with accounts (each including an owners list), item, and request_id; on failure, output contains an error message.
